description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing dependencies, parameter extraction, and request body processing in FastAPI, including handling of parameter annotations, dependency resolution, and form data extraction.

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: Data class holding parameter annotation, dependency, and field info.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: Data class representing the result of dependency resolution, including values, errors, and context.

methods.name: ensure_multipart_is_installed
methods.description: Checks if 'python-multipart' is installed and correctly configured.

methods.name: get_parameterless_sub_dependant
methods.description: Creates a Dependant for a parameterless dependency.

methods.name: get_flat_dependant
methods.description: Flattens nested dependencies into a single Dependant object.

methods.name: get_flat_params
methods.description: Retrieves flattened list of ModelFields from a Dependant.

methods.name: get_typed_signature
methods.description: Returns the function signature with annotated types evaluated.

methods.name: get_typed_annotation
methods.description: Resolves string annotations to actual types, handling ForwardRefs.

methods.name: get_typed_return_annotation
methods.description: Gets the return annotation of a callable with evaluation.

methods.name: get_dependant
methods.description: Constructs a Dependant object for a given path and callable, analyzing parameters.

methods.name: add_non_field_param_to_dependency
methods.description: Assigns special parameter names for non-field dependencies like Request, WebSocket, etc.

methods.name: analyze_param
methods.description: Analyzes a parameter's annotation and default value to determine ModelField and dependency info.

methods.name: add_param_to_fields
methods.description: Adds a ModelField to the appropriate list in a Dependant based on its 'in' parameter.

methods.name: solve_dependencies
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies for a Dependant, including nested dependencies, request data, and context.

methods.name: request_params_to_args
methods.description: Converts request query, header, or path parameters into a dict of arguments for dependency functions.

methods.name: request_body_to_args
methods.description: Extracts and validates request body parameters into a dict of arguments.

methods.name: get_body_field
methods.description: Creates a ModelField representing the combined request body for a path operation.
